% ============================================================================
% הסגנון הנקי (בהשראת מסמך-הייחוס של המשתמש): מונוכרום, בלי קופסאות צבע,
% בלי מספור משוואות. הממשק לסוכנים לא משתנה (exbox/keybox/notebox/equation/align)
% — רק ההגדרות כאן קובעות את המראה. חובה אחרי preamble.tex.
% ============================================================================

% ---- בלי "פרק N" ובלי "חלק I": הכותרות נושאות את השם המלא ("שאלה 1 — נושא") ----
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{-2}

% ---- פלטה מונוכרומית לכל הרכיבים, גם לסביבות שאינן מוגדרות מחדש כאן ----
\definecolor{cBlue}{HTML}{1A1A1A}   \definecolor{cBlueBg}{HTML}{F7F7F7}
\definecolor{cGreen}{HTML}{333333}  \definecolor{cGreenBg}{HTML}{F7F7F7}
\definecolor{cAmber}{HTML}{333333}  \definecolor{cAmberBg}{HTML}{F7F7F7}
\definecolor{cPurple}{HTML}{333333} \definecolor{cPurpleBg}{HTML}{F7F7F7}
\definecolor{cTeal}{HTML}{333333}   \definecolor{cTealBg}{HTML}{F7F7F7}
\definecolor{cRed}{HTML}{333333}    \definecolor{cRedBg}{HTML}{F7F7F7}
\definecolor{cRule}{HTML}{333333}
\definecolor{cTblLine}{HTML}{C8C8C8}\definecolor{cTblBg}{HTML}{FFFFFF}

% ---- קליטת [frametitle={...},nobreak=true,...] בלי mdframed ----
\pgfkeys{/cleanq/.is family,
  /cleanq/frametitle/.store in=\cleanqtitle,
  /cleanq/.unknown/.code={}}

% נוסח השאלה: כותרת מודגשת -> גוף -> קו מפריד -> "פתרון:"
% (כותרת ה-frametitle מדוכאת — כותרת הפרק כבר נושאת את שם השאלה)
\newif\ifcleanqwarned
\renewenvironment{exbox}[1][]{%
  \par\medskip
  \def\cleanqtitle{}\pgfkeys{/cleanq/.cd,#1}%
  % v3.73: the suppression above is DELIBERATE (the chapter heading already
  % carries the question name — the live sites' titles duplicate it verbatim),
  % but it used to be SILENT: author text vanished with zero diagnostic, against
  % the file's own "interface does not change" contract. Warn once per document.
  % NB @-free names: this file is \input where @ is NOT a letter — the
  % first draft used \ifcleanq@warned and died with "Missing \begin{document}"
  % (the stray @warned typeset as preamble text). Measured, then renamed.
  \ifx\cleanqtitle\empty\else\ifcleanqwarned\else
    \PackageWarning{clean-variant}{exbox frametitle is suppressed by the clean
      style (the chapter heading carries the question name); this notice fires
      once}\global\cleanqwarnedtrue\fi\fi
  \noindent\ignorespaces
}{%
  \par\nobreak\smallskip\noindent\textcolor{cRule}{\rule{\linewidth}{0.4pt}}\par\smallskip
  \noindent\textbf{\iflanguage{english}{Solution:}{פתרון:}}\par\nopagebreak\medskip
}

% "לקח למבחן": פסקה מודגשת-פתיח, בלי קופסה
\renewenvironment{keybox}[1][]{%
  \par\medskip
  \def\cleanqtitle{}\pgfkeys{/cleanq/.cd,#1}%
  \noindent\textbf{\ifx\cleanqtitle\empty\iflanguage{english}{Exam takeaway}{לקח למבחן}\else\cleanqtitle\fi.}\ \ignorespaces
}{\par\medskip}

% הערת-מקור/השלמה: פתיח מודגש + גוף בגופן קטן, בלי קופסה
\renewenvironment{notebox}[1][]{%
  \par\smallskip
  \def\cleanqtitle{}\pgfkeys{/cleanq/.cd,#1}%
  \noindent\small\textbf{\ifx\cleanqtitle\empty\iflanguage{english}{Note}{הערה}\else\cleanqtitle\fi.}\ \ignorespaces
}{\par\smallskip}

% ---- v3.78 (BLD-16 postscript): מספרי-שורות חוזרים בקופסאות שהשכבה הזו ----
% ---- מרנדרת בלי מסגרת ----
% The preamble's v3.37 hook blanks \thelstnumber inside the six colored
% boxes because the mdframed BORDER cuts the digits — a rationale that dies
% with the frame. But the etoolbox hook rides \begin{exbox} itself, not the
% mdframed definition, so it outlived the \renewenvironment blocks above and
% every exam-layer in-box listing shipped numberless (measured on the shipped
% PDF with scripts/probe_lstnum.py: computer-architecture-exams p.7 statement
% listing 0 margin digits vs. its unboxed p.8 solution listing 1..24 — 24, not
% the "1..12" this comment claimed until v3.81; the digits hang at x=53.42 for
% 1..9 and x=49.62 for 10..24, the two-digit \llap being wider).
% Contract restore — the file header promises
% "only the look changes": these LATER hooks (registration order wins — they
% run after the preamble's blanking hook) put the number text back for
% EXACTLY the environments this layer renders frameless: exbox/keybox/
% notebox. defbox/thmbox/warnbox keep the preamble's mdframed look here, so
% they stay blanked. Zero reflow by construction: v3.37 kept numbers=left
% alive (the number box is still typeset, its text empty — code x frozen at
% 75.26), so refilling the text moves no glyph (A/B word-position verified).
\AtBeginEnvironment{exbox}{\def\thelstnumber{\arabic{lstnumber}}}
\AtBeginEnvironment{keybox}{\def\thelstnumber{\arabic{lstnumber}}}
\AtBeginEnvironment{notebox}{\def\thelstnumber{\arabic{lstnumber}}}

% ---- ביטול מספור משוואות: מספר מופיע רק אם מפנים אליו (\eqref) בפועל ----
% (דריסת align וכו' ישירות מתנגשת עם תיקוני babel/bidi — לכן showonlyrefs.)
\mathtoolsset{showonlyrefs=true}

% ---- "טבלה N" רציף (מונה הפרקים קפוא תחת secnumdepth=-2 — בלי קידומת 0.) ----
\renewcommand{\thetbl}{\arabic{tbl}}

% ---- עזרי מבחן (נקודות-ההתאמה מתועדות בראש הקובץ) ----
% v3.73: \qlabel — the ONLY safe way to label a question heading here. Under
% secnumdepth=-2 \chapter steps NO counter (report.cls guards \refstepcounter
% with \ifnum\c@secnumdepth>\m@ne), so a plain \label after \chapter captures
% whatever stepped last — measured: \newlabel{ch:q2}{{1}...{fig.0.1}} = the
% preceding FIGURE's number, and \ref printed 1 for question 2; with nothing
% stepped, an EMPTY number. Same family as BLD-13/BIDI-50/BIDI-56, in the layer
% those fixes never reached. \qlabel owns the label state:
%   \chapter{שאלה 2 — נושא}\qlabel{שאלה 2}{ch:q2}   ->  \ref{ch:q2} = "שאלה 2"
% (\nameref{ch:q2} and \hyperref[ch:q2]{...} also work without \qlabel.)
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\qlabel}[2]{\def\@currentlabel{#1}\phantomsection\label{#2}}
\makeatother
\newcommand{\pts}[1]{{\small(#1)}}                               % ניקוד: \pts{30\%}
\newcommand{\finalans}[1]{\boxed{#1}}                            % תשובה סופית במסגרת דקה
% איור שנחתך מהמקור: \srcfig{width-fraction}{file}{כיתוב}
\providecommand{\srcfigdir}{figures}
% v3.73: the caption now goes through \figcap. The old hand-written gray line
% was byte-for-byte the BLD-13 idiom inside a shipped macro: no \refstepcounter,
% so a \label in #3 bound to the ambient anchor — measured: \newlabel{fig:src}
% {{}...{tbl.0.1}} (EMPTY number, hyperlink jumping to the preceding TABLE) and
% "ראה איור  לעיל" with a hole where the number belongs. \figcap steps the real
% fig counter: number prints, \ref works, the anchor is the figure's own.
% v3.80 (BLD-37, the fig side this layer never got): the image is now a
% MEASURED object. \figcap raises its anchor by \lakinfigraise+42pt, and
% \lakinfigraise is written ONLY by \lakin@grabfig, which preamble.tex runs in
% the tikzpic/qcirc end-hook. A bare \begin{center} never triggered it, so
% every \srcfig hit the 0pt sentinel, \figcap fell back to the plain
% \refstepcounter, and hyperref dropped the anchor ON the caption line —
% clicking "איור N" scrolled the whole image off the top. Measured fleet-wide
% before this fix: 13 of 127 fig dests sat 12.9pt (or 3.2pt, caption on the
% next page) above their own caption, in three exam collections; the 275pt
% datapath figure on computer-architecture-exams p.76 was fully hidden after
% the jump. And because \lakinfigraise is deliberately NOT cleared except at
% an island's BEGIN (a captionless island must keep its height for the next
% \figcap), a \srcfig following a captionless tikzpic inherited that island's
% STALE height and landed inside its own image anyway — 7 further sites, none
% of them below the DEST-AT-CAPTION floor, i.e. invisible to R6b. Hence BOTH
% tokens below: the clear makes the sentinel honest, the grab measures THIS
% image. Zero reflow BY CONSTRUCTION — v3.74b's \lakin@grabfig only READS the
% tail node's dimensions (it removes and re-inserts nothing), so no box, glue
% or penalty is added; A/B over the four exam collections that carry this
% layer: 0 differing glyph records and 0 differing drawing records out of
% 579,594 + 6,447. Of their 30 fig destinations 24 moved — the 20 broken ones
% plus 4 whose stale raise happened to land clear anyway — and the dest NAMES
% normalize from fig.0.N to fig.N, i.e. onto the name the measured path in the
% same documents already used (particles-nuclei-exams shipped both spellings).
\newcommand{\srcfig}[3]{\global\lakinfigraise 0pt\relax%
  \begin{center}\includegraphics[width=#1\linewidth]{\srcfigdir/#2}%
    \csname lakin@grabfig\endcsname\end{center}\figcap{#3}}
